title: hive-pool answer-question: request body
description: Records one answer exactly as given against a question, its card and its round at their revisions, and applies it in the same transaction: releases the hold, completes the question, defers it, or records it unreconciled when the question has moved on. Two answers with the same source are one answer: the second returns the first's receipt and writes nothing. The operation word persists answers through.

card.description: The card the answer was given on, with every revision the Hive Mind saw.

text.description: The free text exactly as given. Empty only when an option was chosen with no text.

supersedes.description: The sequence of an earlier applied answer this one replaces. Requires the envelope's authority to be the Hive Mind's word.

reconciles.description: The sequence of an unreconciled answer this one settles at the current revision.
